# Ticket T07

The gateway forwards the session table and keeps the previous copy for audit.
The audit trail summarizes the session table before the next window opens.
The ingest service validates the pending batches before the next window opens.
The audit trail rotates a shard manifest unless an operator pins the revision.
The scheduler rebuilds the session table once the backlog drops below the soft limit.
The gateway defers a checksum ledger and reports the outcome to the journal.
Each replica forwards the overflow buffer while holding the coordination lock.
The cache layer summarizes the outbound events once the backlog drops below the soft limit.
A background worker summarizes the pending batches and keeps the previous copy for audit.

## Action

Set `s07.mode` to `hybrid` in config/app.conf.
